answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Reaching the falcon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The mesa holds work receipts rather than names, so the ferrous of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
